requirement:
The coverage overview counts documented source items carrying coverage
annotations, once per source item, and groups them by source file. Directory
summaries include these items in all descendants,
regardless of which groups are expanded. Read or parse failures that prevent
discovering annotations are visible and are not presented as a complete
absence of documentation.
rationale: The three marked tests in `src/execution_coverage/book.rs` cover every obligation in `requirements.test-coverage.index.gaps.summary`. I read their source and did not request implementation source. **Counting once per source item, grouped by file** - `mod[tests]/fn[documented_items_are_counted_once_with_browsable_directory_and_file_groups]` builds a fixture where `code.rs` has two `habeas:coverage` fenced cites on the single item `fn one`. It also has a root-level cite and a plain item in `src/direct.rs`. - It asserts the overall text "7 documented source items carrying coverage annotations". That total is only reachable if `fn one`'s two cites count once. The seven items are 2 in `code.rs`, 2 in `src/direct.rs`, 1 each in `src/deep/nested.rs`, `vendor/foreign.rs` and `docs_only/deep/item.rs`. - Each file card has a per-file count cell (`{expected_count}`) of 2, 2 and 1 as expected. The card also lists each item location (`File root`, `fn[one]`, `fn[direct]`, `fn[second]`, `fn[unexplained]`), which shows the grouping by source file. - `src/pass.rs`, which has no annotations, is asserted to be absent. **Directory summaries include all descendants** - The test asserts the summary count for `src` is 3: two items in `direct.rs` plus one in the nested `src/deep`. - It asserts `src/deep` is 1, `vendor` is 1, `docs_only` is 1 and `docs_only/deep` is 1. `docs_only` has no direct files, so its count comes only from a descendant. - `assert_directory_contents` and the check that the `docs_only` ancestor has no `data-file=` entries of its own confirm the nesting. - The counts sit in the always-present `` text. File cards are asserted collapsed (`aria-expanded="false"`, `hidden`), yet the counts are still correct. That covers "regardless of which groups are expanded". **Failures are visible and not shown as complete absence** - `mod[tests]/fn[empty_documentation_and_source_failures_are_distinct]` first checks that a clean empty repository shows "No documented coverage gaps are present." - It then adds a parse-failing `broken.rs`. The overview must contain "Source notes unavailable" and `broken.rs`, and must not contain the "No documented…" text. A notes chapter for the file must also exist. - It also makes `.gitignore` invalid (`[z-a]`). The overview must show "cannot discover reference sources" and again must not claim absence. - `mod[tests]/fn[missing_and_unreadable_sources_produce_overview_diagnostics]` covers an unreadable file (mode 000) and a file in the git index but missing from disk. Both must show "Source notes unavailable", and the missing case must show "code.rs: current source is missing". Neither may show the "No documented…" text. - It also checks the negative boundary: missing files that are excluded or disallowed must not raise a failure diagnostic and must not hide the empty-documentation message. Each obligation has an exercising scenario and a concrete assertion, and the tests carry `{test}` references to the subject. I found no gap.
